name: constructing-software-stepwise
description: Stepwise design ledger CLI (Effect) and interactive design reader (SolidJS).

scripts.build: pnpm run build:cli && pnpm run build:viewer
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p viewer/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p test/browser/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm test && pnpm run test:browser
